tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ro snyoms kyi dkar chag bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig chos kyi sgo mang 'dir// su chud rnam mkhyen gzigs mo la// rtag par 'byams des der btud nas// gong ma'i gsung gces tho rtse bya// 'dir dpal dgyes pa rdo rje rgyud gsum gtso bor gton pa'i man ngag 'byung ba ro snyoms zhes grags pa phul du phyin pa/ rnal 'byor gyi spyod pa thams cad kyi gsang tshig /jo bo nā ro ta pa'i gdams ngag gi nying khu 'di la skor mdzod chen mo gsum ste/ gter mdzod bka' rgya can/ yang mdzod thugs kyi me long*/ gsang mdzod sbas ba mig 'byed gsum las/ dang po la khrigs/ khrid/ zhal gdams gsum/ dang po la gnang mi gnang*/ nges pa can bzhi/ bsdus don dar gdugs ma gsum chos rjes/ mtshams sbyor/ khog don gnyis/ 'gag dril/ thugs kyi nying khu gnyis chos rjes so// rnam bshad nor bu 'do sgron rlung gi bca' gzhi dang*/ 'byung chung ro snyoms rtsa ba ras chung pas mdzad pa ro snyoms bka' mar grags pa/ 'grel pa zhal gdams chos rjes/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang rga lo'i lugs/ lha srin sde brgyad gnod rtags/ gnyis pa khrid la/ khrid kyi tho yig gter khung ba la gnang ba/ sangs rgyas dbon gyi don khrid/ lo ras kyi ro snyoms bsdus pa/ rgo tshang pa'i sgang 'dril/ de'i zhal gdams spyil dkar ba'i gsung*/ gsum pa la/ gsang spyod 'grim dpe ma chos rjes/ de las rgyas pa rlung gis mdzad pa/ gsang spyod bka' rgya ma rgod tshang pa'i zin bris/ shin tu spros med kyi rtsa ba chos rjes/ 'grel pa shang zhig me mchod dang bdud rtsi lnga chos rjes/ nad 'don springs yig ma chos rjes/ dang po las spros pa gcig dgu phrugs ma/ tshigs drug ma/ yul nyer bzhi'i nad 'don/ bya spu gnam gtor/ snying rje'i sgo nas nad 'don/ zlog sgom rkyang 'ded/ zlog sgom gyi dmigs pa/ nad 'don spas pa mig 'byed kyi skor/ 'byung bzhi ro snyoms/

mdze pho ro snyoms/ spas pa mig 'byed la gling nas brgyud pa'ang yod la gzhan rnams chos rje nyid kyi gsung la zin bris byas pa/ ro snyoms kyi lus sbyong*/ yang mdzod ni skor mdzod le'u drug pa ste ro snyoms bsdus pa zhes bya'o// de gnyis ni grol lam gtso bor byas pa'o// gsum pa gsang mdzod spas pa mig 'byed la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzad pa rdo rje'i glu/ tilli pas mdzad pa'i gsang tshig nā ro pas mdzad pa'i spyod pa chos kyi glu/ ti pus mdzad pa'i gsang sngags chos drug ste/ 'di ni ro snyoms rgyas pa'o/ zhes pa rnams tshad thub kyi yi ge shin tu gces pa yin la/ gzhung dang gter mdzod ces grags pa ni nor bu 'do sgron du 'du/ 'di las gzhan pa rnam grangs te grub thob rnams kyi zin bris tha dad kyang don mthun pas tshang bar bri mi dgos zhes padma dkar po chos 'di la dbyad pa'i pha mthar son pa des sbyar ba yin no/// /sarba maṅga laṃ//
